_comment: Referents that never become a word at all -- a pack author's hard fence (design 8.4), checked at
derivation rather than at resolution so a forbidden thing is honestly absent instead of silently
dropped. Distinct from `withheld`, which is a timing fence on things that DO become writable later.
REVERSED 2026-09-06 (Jonah): the mod's own stones are NOT forbidden. Deretheni and temperstone were
both fenced here on the argument that naming 'an Age full of it' is 8.4's duplication exploit. The
ruling now is that they are writable and gated by PRICE instead -- they carry
`requires_masterwork_ink`, so an Age made of one costs the rarest ink there is, which is the same
brake a sea of diamonds already runs into. Rarity of the find does the rest.
So this file is empty again, and that is the honest state rather than an oversight: nothing in the
pack currently needs a prohibition that a price cannot express.
